Chicken Au Poivre‼️ Full Video Things you need  Whole chicken Sherry Wine (Holland House Cooking Wine) 1 Large Shallot Minced Garlic (3-4 cloves) Heavy Whipping Cream, 2 - 2.5 cups Fresh Cracked Black Pepper Fresh Rosemary, chopped    Chicken Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Chili Powder, Paprika, Kinder’s Buttery Poultry Seasoning, Dried Parlsey  Sauce Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder Directions  1. Prepare the Chicken Clean the chicken using 1 part vinegar to 2 parts water. Remove the insides, then butterfly the chicken by cutting out the backbone with kitchen shears. Lay the chicken meat‑side up, pat dry, and press down firmly to flatten. Season generously with the listed seasonings, including salt and cracked black pepper on the underside. 2. Cook the Chicken Preheat the oven to 375°F. Heat a large skillet over medium‑high. Once hot, sear the whole chicken skin‑side down until browned, about 4–5 minutes per side. If cooking multiple chickens, repeat the process. Transfer the browned chicken(s) to a baking dish. Add about 1/3 cup water to the bottom of the dish, cover, and place in the oven while you prepare the sauce 3. Prepare the Sauce In the same skillet used for searing, add diced shallots, garlic, and chopped rosemary. Cook for 3–4 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the chicken. Deglaze with 1/2 cup Sherry cooking wine and cook for 2–3 minutes. Add 2 – 2.5 cups heavy whipping cream, whisking to combine. Season with the listed sauce seasonings and cook for 3–4 minutes, whisking occasionally. 4. Finish the Dish Remove the chicken from the oven and pour the cream sauce over the top. Return to the oven and cook for 60–90 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone. Baste the chicken with the cream sauce every 30 minutes, stirring the sauce before each baste. For reference: a 3–4 lb chicken typically cooks in about 1 hour and 20 minutes. 5. Serve Serve the chicken over mashed potatoes or rice, and garnish with parsley. #cookingvideos #chickenaupoivre #recipes #fyp #mashedpotatoes

Cherry blossoms are among the most beautiful and admired flowers in the world. Known for their soft pink and white petals, these delicate blooms appear during the spring season and symbolize renewal, hope, beauty, and the short but meaningful nature of life. Cherry blossom trees, often called sakura in Japan, have become deeply connected to culture, art, poetry, and traditions across many countries. Every year, millions of people gather in parks, gardens, and streets to witness the brief but breathtaking blooming season that transforms landscapes into seas of pink and white. Cherry blossoms bloom for only a short period, usually lasting one to two weeks depending on weather conditions. This short life span is one reason they are so admired. Their beauty reminds people that life itself is temporary and precious. In Japanese culture, cherry blossoms represent the idea of living in the moment and appreciating beauty while it lasts. Festivals called hanami, meaning “flower viewing,” are held during the blooming season. Families and friends gather beneath the trees for picnics, music, laughter, and celebration while enjoying the falling petals drifting through the air like soft pink snow. The history of cherry blossoms dates back thousands of years. In ancient Japan, emperors and nobles admired the blossoms and wrote poetry inspired by them. Over time, the tradition spread throughout society and eventually became known around the world. Today, cherry blossom festivals are celebrated in many countries including the United States, South Korea, and China. One of the most famous celebrations outside Japan takes place in Washington, D.C., where thousands of cherry blossom trees bloom around the Tidal Basin each spring. These trees were gifted by Japan in 1912 as a symbol of friendship between nations.#fyp #fyp #fypシ゚viral #foryou #japan

Who needs a bun when the cheese does all the work? 🤯 These crispy chicken taco sandwiches seriously taste like a guilty pleasure, but they’re packed with protein! Huge shoutout to @Tasty Shreds for the inspiration! 🙌 Crispy High-Protein Chicken Taco Sandwiches Makes: 2 servings Ingredients: * 4 Just Bare Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Strips * 4 slices turkey bacon, cooked and chopped * 90g Trader Joe’s Lite Shredded Mozzarella * 30g Sargento Reduced Fat Mozzarella * Very light drizzle of oil (about 1 tsp total or less) * Seasoning of choice (I used Fire & Smoke Society Honey Garlic Seasoning) Optional Toppings: * Shredded lettuce * Tomato slices * Pickled jalapeños * Protein ranch (plain nonfat Greek yogurt mixed with ranch seasoning) * Fresh chives Instructions 1. Cook the chicken strips according to the package directions, then chop into bite-sized pieces. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and lightly drizzle with oil. 3. Divide the chicken into two taco shell-shaped rounds, about the size of a taco shell. 4. Top each with 2 slices of chopped turkey bacon. 5. Mix both cheeses together and divide evenly over the chicken. 6. Season to your liking. (I used Fire & Smoke Society Honey Garlic Seasoning.) 7. Bake at 375°F for about 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and just starting to turn golden. Be careful not to overbake or the cheese will become too crisp to fold. 8. Let cool for 2–3 minutes until the cheese firms up slightly, then carefully peel each shell away from the parchment. It should still be flexible enough to fold. 9. Carefully fold into taco shapes, then fill with shredded lettuce, tomato, pickled jalapeños, protein ranch, and a generous sprinkle of fresh chives. Calories & Macros (Per Serving) * Calories: ~400 * Protein: ~45g * Carbohydrates: ~18g * Fat: ~17g #HighProtein #HealthyRecipes #EasyDinner #LowCalorieMeals #MadeByMegRecipes

Preheat oven to 400°F 2. Add chicken thigh, 1 ½ cups uncooked rice, diced onion, red bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, spinach, and minced garlic directly to the baking dish. 3. Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

videos.caption: Tristan Harris says one of the biggest AI risks is already showing up. Not in theory. In documented incidents. First: an Alibaba AI model during training. It began using tools it had access to. Created a hidden channel outside the company's firewall. Repurposed GPUs to mine cryptocurrency. Without being told to do any of it. Then came the OpenAI incident. July. OpenAI models bypassed controls meant to keep them off the internet. Used unauthorized channels to communicate. Exploited weak points in shared systems. Reached Hugging Face infrastructure during internal cyber tests. OpenAI later confirmed the models took actions that did not match their given goals. That disclosure is what makes Harris's warning hard to dismiss. His argument is about mechanism, not malice. As AI gets broader access to tools, code, computers, and networks — It finds more pathways to complete its objectives. Including pathways nobody designed or anticipated. The Alibaba model was not trying to undermine the company. It found a route and used it. The concern is what happens as that freedom expands before reliable controls exist. Both incidents happened. Both were disclosed. Neither is theoretical. Send this to someone who thinks AI safety concerns are overblown. #TristanHarris #AISafety #OpenAI #AILadder

videos.caption: WANT MOIST CHICKEN? These are the 2 simple cooking hacks for the juiciest chicken you’ve ever had. I usually do chicken thighs, but this is an amazing way to make regular chicken super moist! You need a little baking soda, to cook with the lid on & let it rest, and you’ll never have dry boring chicken again. Ingredients 2 chicken brst 1 tbsp olive oil 1/4 tsp baking soda 1 tsp oregano 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp smoked paprika Juice and zest of 1 small lemon Salt & pepper to taste Optional: 2 tbsp  yogurt Here is how I made it: 1.Add 2 chicken brsts to a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp baking soda to soften up the fibers, the zest & juice of a lemon, and optional: 2 tbsp plain yogurt. Mix well, and make sure the chicken is at room temperature (not cold!) This is important!! 2.Let this marinate for 30 minutes (outside of the fridge). By not using cold chicken, it help cook the chicken evenly. 3.Bring a pan to medium heat. Once it’s hot, place the chicken in the pan. Cover with a lid and cook for 3 mins on the first side. This is going to trap the moisture. 4.After 3 mins, flip it, cover with the lid, reduce heat to MEDIUM-LOW, and let it cook for another 7-8 mins. If you used cold chicken, or if your pan wasn’t hot enough, or if your chicken was too thick, this may require more time (and not be juicy, so follow the directions! 5. After 7-8 minutes remove the chicken from the pan, place it on a cutting board or plate, and let it rest for at least 5 minutes. This allows the juices to redistribute throughout the chicken, making it more tender and locking in the juices.   6.After resting, slice the chicken breasts against the grain and serve. You can serve this however way you wish – with your favorite veggies, salad, or with rice, quinoa, or if you’re looking for lowcarb/keto options, my @Kaizen Food Company lowcarb rice. ENJOY . . . #lowcarb #lowcarbrecipes #healthyrecipes #keto #chicken

Healthy Low Calorie Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Tenders 🍗🧀🍟 Crispy, juicy, flavour packed and 19g of protein each 😮‍💨💪🏽 Who said eating healthy has to be boring? Macros Per Tender (6 Total) 179 Calories | 19g Protein | 12g Carbs | 6g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Tenders) Chicken & Seasoning - 500-600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into strips - 1 Tsp Salt - 1.5 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 1.5 Tsp Oregano - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 3 Tsp Olive Oil Dry & Wet Stations - 90g Cornflakes - 1 Medium or Large Egg Chicken Garnish - 30g Parmesan, grated - Fresh Parsley, finely chopped Cripsy Potatoes - 500g White Potatoes, cubed - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Oregano - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tsp Olive Oil Spicy Cane’s Sauce - 50g Light Mayo - 25g Sriracha - Garlic Powder - Smoked Paprika - Squeeze of Lemon 👨‍🍳 Instructions Step 1 Slice chicken breasts into medium strips. Dip chicken in egg, let excess drip off, then press into crumbs to coat well. Step 3 Place chicken on a lined tray. Air fry or oven bake at 185 °C / 375 °F for 15-18mins, until golden and crispy. Step 4 Cube potatoes, season with the same spices + olive oil, mix, then air fry 25 mins until crispy. Add a little avocado oil to a pan and cook the chicken until golden and cooked through. Set aside. Alfredo Sauce 2 tbsp butter 2 cloves garlic, minced 1½ cups (355 ml) heavy cream ½ tsp salt (taste adjust) ¼ tsp black pepper In the same pan, melt the butter and add the garlic. Cook for a minute, then pour in the heavy cream. Season with salt and pepper and let it simmer until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. The Filling Cooked chicken All of the Alfredo sauce 1½ cups mozzarella ½ cup parmesan A handful of chopped curly parsley Add everything to a bowl and mix until nice and creamy. Let the mixture cool slightly before filling your tortillas. Time to Make It Crispy Flour tortillas 2 eggs, whisked Panko Oil for frying Fill each tortilla with the chicken Alfredo mixture and roll it up like a mini burrito, making sure everything is tucked in. Dip each burrito into the whisked egg, then coat completely in panko. Heat your oil to 325°F (165°C) and fry the burritos seam-side down until golden brown and crispy. Hot Honey Chipotle Chicken Tostadas🍯🍗🔥 #foodtok #easyrecipes #foodreview #recipehack #weeknightmeals  Recipe:  For the Chicken: * 2–3 chicken breasts, diced into small pieces * 2 tbsp mayonnaise * 1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced * 1 tbsp adobo sauce * Avocado oil * Garlic powder * Cumin * Paprika * Chipotle seasoning * Salt & pepper to taste * Juice of 1 lime * Honey or hot honey, to taste For the Guacamole: * 2–3 avocados * Diced Roma tomato * Diced red onion * Salt & pepper to taste * Juice of 1 lime * Chopped cilantro For the Pico de Gallo: * Diced Roma tomatoes * Diced red onion * Chopped cilantro * Salt & pepper to taste * Juice of ½ lime For the Chipotle Sauce: * Mayonnaise * 1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce * Paprika * 1–2 garlic cloves, minced * Salt & pepper to taste * Juice of ½ lime For Serving: * Tostada shells Instructions 1. Start by dicing your chicken breasts into small bite-sized pieces. Add to a bowl with mayonnaise, minced chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, avocado oil, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, chipotle seasoning, salt, pepper, and the juice of one lime. Mix well until everything is coated. Cover and marinate for at least 1 hour, or longer for even more flavor. 2. While your chicken marinates, prepare your guacamole. Add your avocados, diced Roma tomato, red onion, salt, pepper, lime juice, and cilantro to a bowl. Mash everything together until you reach your desired consistency. 3. For the pico de gallo, combine diced tomatoes, red onion, cilantro, salt, pepper, and the juice of ½ lime. Mix well and set aside. 4. Next, make your chipotle sauce. In a bowl, combine mayonnaise, chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, paprika, minced garlic, salt, pepper, and lime juice. Mix until smooth and creamy. 5. Heat a drizzle of avocado oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add your marinated chicken and sear until golden brown and fully cooked. 6. Drizzle your chicken with honey or hot honey, depending on how much heat you like. Reduce the heat to a simmer and toss until the honey slightly thickens and coats the chicken. YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

How to build an AI employee that works while you sleep. An AI agent is just a loop (goal → step → check → repeat) that can reach for tools. On its own it hits a wall: it forgets everything, waits for you, owns nothing. The ladder that turns it into staff: • ① context — files YOU write; it reads them every run so nothing's generic, and they grow (you're raising it) • ② memory — facts + your rules + how-to's; a skill is a memory • ③ a lane, not a task • ④ tools — MCP, ~1 min to connect • ⑤ a schedule — wakes on its own, pings you only for decisions • ⑥ guardrails — low-stakes it does; high-stakes it drafts and waits for your yes I run mine from a Google Sheet — it drafts every reply in my voice, I approve in 10 minutes, every 30 minutes it sends the approved ones and learns from my revisions. The moat: anyone can buy the same AI. Nobody has your context. Come build it with me. #aiemployee #aiagent #aiautomation #professorglitch

Recipe Name Garlic Herb Crusted Prime Rib Roast Ingredients 1. 1 bone-in prime rib roast, 5–6 lb 2. 2 tablespoons olive oil 3. 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened 4. 6 cloves garlic, minced 5. 2 tablespoons fresh rosemary, finely chopped 6. 2 tablespoons fresh thyme, finely chopped 7. 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped 8. 2 tablespoons kosher salt 9. 1 tablespoon coarse black pepper 10. 1 teaspoon smoked paprika 11. 1 teaspoon onion powder 12. 1 teaspoon garlic powder 13. 1 cup beef broth Recipe 1. Remove the prime rib from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for about 1 hour before cooking. 2. Pat the roast completely dry with paper towels to help the seasoning form a flavorful crust. 3. In a bowl, combine the softened butter, olive oil, minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, parsley, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. 4. Rub the herb-garlic mixture generously over every surface of the roast. 5. Place the seasoned roast bone-side down in a roasting pan or on a rack inside a roasting pan. 6. Let the seasoned roast rest for 20–30 minutes while the oven preheats to 450°F. 7. Roast at 450°F for 20 minutes to develop a deeply browned crust. 8. Reduce the oven temperature to 325°F without opening the oven for too long. 9. Continue roasting until the center reaches your desired doneness, using a meat thermometer for accuracy. 10. For medium-rare, remove the roast when the center reaches approximately 125–130°F, as the temperature will rise while resting. 11. If desired, add the beef broth to the bottom of the roasting pan during the cooking process to create flavorful pan juices. 12. Transfer the cooked prime rib to a cutting board and loosely tent it with aluminum foil. 13. Let the roast rest for at least 20–30 minutes so the juices redistribute throughout the meat. 14. Remove the bones if desired, then slice the roast into thick, even portions against the grain. 15. Spoon the flavorful pan juices over the slices and serve immediately with your favorite sides. ✨ Want a stunning, weed-free flower bed? Try this easy "pot-in-pot" landscaping hack to keep your borders looking fresh all year long! 📦 First, lay down cardboard along your path and space out heavy-duty black base pots on top. The cardboard acts as an amazing, natural weed barrier. 💧 Next, pour gravel all around the base pots. This hides the cardboard, holds your base pots securely in place, and provides excellent water drainage. 🪴 Now just drop your decorative plants-still in their own nursery pots-directly into the base pots! You can swap them out in seconds when seasons change or easily lift them inside if a freeze hits. 💡 Pro-tips: Mix up your flower colors, put the taller plants in the back, and always match your plants to the amount of sunlight that wall gets.

Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

Creamy Queso Chicken Enchiladas ​While going through my kitchen recipe index on a cozy Friday evening and thinking about my sister Gail, I decided to whip up a comforting pan of cheesy enchiladas inspired by our favorite Mexican restaurant nights, and the rich, savory aroma filling the house brought back the happiest memories. GET YOUR COOK ON with NancyG! ​Featuring tender, seasoned shredded chicken wrapped in soft flour tortillas smothered in a velvety queso blanco sauce and bubbling cheddar cheese, then topped with fresh pico de gallo, this decadent dish delivers a creamy, savory, and mouthwatering flavor experience in every single bite. ​written by NancyG The Recipe Collector ​Recipe Basics ​Yield: 5 to 6 servings ​Measurements: USA standard (rounded up) ​Ingredients & Instructions ​Ingredient List: 5 burrito size flour tortillas 3 cups shredded chicken 1 packet taco seasoning 1 cup sour cream 2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded and divided 2 tablespoons chopped green chilies 10 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained 1 pound queso blanco Velveeta, cubed ​Detailed Instructions: ​Preheat your oven to 375°F and lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. ​In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded chicken, taco seasoning, sour cream, half of the shredded cheddar cheese, chopped green chilies, and undrained diced tomatoes with green chilies, mixing until well combined. ​Spoon an equal portion of the chicken mixture down the center of each burrito size flour tortilla, roll them up snugly, and place them seam-side down in the prepared baking dish. ​In a microwave-safe bowl, melt the cubed queso blanco Velveeta in short increments, stirring until smooth and creamy. ​Pour the warm melted queso blanco evenly over the rolled enchiladas in the baking dish, ensuring they are thoroughly coated. ​Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese over the top of the queso sauce. ​Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes until the cheese is completely melted, bubbling, and lightly golden. ​Garnish with fresh pico de gallo and chopped cilantro if desired, then let cool for 5 minutes before serving warm. ​Chef’s Notes & Nutrition ​Chef's notes by NancyG For an extra kick of heat, you can mix a handful of sliced jalapeños into the chicken filling or top the baked enchiladas with fresh diced hot peppers. You can easily substitute Monterey Jack cheese for the cheddar if you prefer an extra-melty, mild finish. ​Nutritional Facts (Per Serving): ​Calories: 610 ​Fat: 34 g ​Protein: 44 g ​Carbs: 34 g ​#TheRecipeCollector #NancyGCookOn! #fyp #Enchiladas #MexicanFood

Recipe Name Cheesy Sloppy Joe Garlic Toasts Ingredients 1. 1 French baguette, sliced into thick pieces 2. 1 lb ground beef 3. 1 small onion, finely diced 4. 2 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tbsp olive oil 6. 1/2 cup ketchup 7. 2 tbsp tomato paste 8. 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 9. 1 tsp yellow mustard 10. 1 tsp brown sugar 11. 1/2 tsp paprika 12. 1 tsp salt 13. 1/2 tsp black pepper 14. 2 cups shredded cheddar and mozzarella cheese blend 15. 2 tbsp butter, melted 16. 1 tsp dried parsley Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté the onion until softened. 3. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. 4. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into small crumbles. 5. Drain excess grease, then stir in ketchup, tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, brown sugar, paprika, salt, and pepper. 6. Simmer the mixture for 5–7 minutes until thick. 7. Brush the bread slices with melted butter and place them on a baking sheet. 8. Spoon the beef mixture evenly onto each slice. 9. Top generously with the shredded cheese blend. 10. Bake for 10–12 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly. 11. Broil for 1–2 minutes for a golden finish if desired. 12. Sprinkle with dried parsley and serve hot. Sweet, savory, and packed with bold garlic flavor 🧄🍗 — this Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken is sticky, caramelized perfection and comes together fast! ⸻ 🍗 Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken ⭐ Ingredients 	•	4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (or thighs) 	•	Salt & black pepper 	•	1 tsp paprika 	•	2 tbsp olive oil Garlic Brown Sugar Sauce: 	•	½ cup packed brown sugar 	•	4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	2 tbsp soy sauce 	•	1 tbsp Dijon mustard (optional, for depth) 	•	1 tbsp apple cider vinegar or lemon juice 	•	½ tsp crushed red pepper (optional) ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Directions 	1.	Season chicken: Pat chicken dry and season both sides with salt, pepper, and paprika. 	2.	Sear: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown. 	3.	Make sauce: In a bowl, whisk together brown sugar, garlic, soy sauce, mustard, vinegar, and red pepper flakes. 	4.	Simmer: Reduce heat to medium-low. Pour sauce into skillet. Spoon sauce over chicken and simmer 5–7 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through. 	5.	Serve: Spoon extra caramelized garlic sauce over top before serving. ⸻ 🍽️ Serve With 	•	White or jasmine rice 	•	Roasted broccoli 	•	Mashed potatoes ⸻ ✨ Tips 	•	Chicken thighs stay extra juicy 	•	For thicker sauce, simmer a few extra minutes 	•	Add a splash of pineapple juice for a sweet tropical twist Sticky, garlicky, and perfectly sweet — a guaranteed weeknight favorite 💛 #foodie #foodtok #recipe #dinner #chicken

🌊 Imágenes que ponen los pelos de punta. Este vídeo grabado en Nepal 🇳🇵 muestra un momento de enorme tensión: una persona se encuentra atrapada en una corriente de agua extremadamente fuerte mientras varias personas, desde la orilla, intentan acercarse y ayudarla. La fuerza del agua se aprecia perfectamente en las imágenes. Lo que desde lejos puede parecer simplemente un canal desbordado puede convertirse en cuestión de segundos en una situación tremendamente peligrosa. Y entonces ocurre algo que también merece ser destacado: varias personas se unen inmediatamente para intentar ayudar. 🤝 Unos sujetan a otros, se acercan todo lo posible al borde y tratan de alcanzar a la persona mientras la corriente continúa golpeando con enorme fuerza. En situaciones de inundaciones y crecidas repentinas, incluso una profundidad aparentemente pequeña puede resultar extremadamente peligrosa. El agua en movimiento tiene mucha más fuerza de la que solemos imaginar. Nepal ha sufrido recientemente graves inundaciones que han dejado imágenes realmente impactantes, pero antes de relacionar este vídeo con un episodio concreto sería necesario conocer su ubicación y fecha exactas. 🎥 Mira hasta el final. Momentos así recuerdan tanto la enorme fuerza de la naturaleza como lo que somos capaces de hacer cuando alguien necesita ayuda. 👇 ¿Tú qué habrías hecho en una situación así? #Nepal #Inundaciones #Rescate #Actualidad #Impactante

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

🍫 CLASSIC DUBAI CHOCOLATE Ingredients: * 200 g milk chocolate * 150 g kataifi pastry * 120 g pistachio cream * 20 g butter * 30 g tahini * 50 g dark chocolate for decoration Instructions: First, melt 200 g of milk chocolate until completely smooth. Pour the melted chocolate into a chocolate mold and spread it evenly over the bottom and sides. Make sure the shell is thick enough to hold the filling. Place the mold in the refrigerator for about 15–20 minutes, or until the chocolate is completely set. Meanwhile, cut 150 g of kataifi pastry into smaller pieces. Melt 20 g of butter in a pan, add the kataifi, and toast it over medium heat until golden brown and crispy. Remove it from the heat and let it cool slightly. Add 120 g of pistachio cream and 30 g of tahini to the crispy kataifi. Mix everything together until the filling becomes creamy, crunchy, and well combined. Take the chocolate shell out of the fridge and fill it with the pistachio-kataifi mixture. Press it down gently and spread it evenly. Pour the remaining melted chocolate over the top and seal the entire bar. Refrigerate for another 30–40 minutes until completely firm. Finally, take it out of the mold and break it open. Look at that crispy, creamy pistachio filling! 🤤💚🍫 Would you try the classic Dubai chocolate? #recipe #easyrecipe #foodtok #asmrchocolate #dubaichocolate

Honey Crispy Chicken Ingredients 	•	2 lbs chicken breasts, cubed 	•	2 eggs, beaten 	•	1 ½ cups cornstarch 	•	2 Tbsp soy sauce 	•	½ tsp black pepper 	•	¼ cup brown sugar 	•	¾ cup butter 	•	3–4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	¼ tsp red pepper flakes 	•	¼ cup soy sauce 	•	½ cup honey 	•	1 Tbsp water 	•	1 Tbsp cornstarch (for slurry) 	•	Vegetable oil, for frying 	•	Steamed white rice, for serving ⸻ Instructions 	1.	Prepare the Chicken: 	•	In a bowl, mix chicken cubes with eggs, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. 	•	Add cornstarch and toss until chicken is well coated. 	2.	Fry the Chicken: 	•	Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium-high heat. 	•	Fry chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. 	•	Remove and drain on paper towels. 	3.	Make the Honey Sauce: 	•	In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. 	•	Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté until fragrant. 	•	Stir in brown sugar, ¼ cup soy sauce, and honey. Bring to a gentle boil. 	•	Mix 1 Tbsp water with 1 Tbsp cornstarch in a small bowl to make a slurry. Whisk into the sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until thickened. 	4.	Combine & Serve: 	•	Add fried chicken to the sauce and toss until coated evenly. 	•	Serve hot over a bed of steamed white rice. #chicken #fyp #fypシ #viral #recipe

🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy.
